title: Quickly Charred Quesadilla Quince Quesadilla
description: Garlicky, crumbly, crowd-pleasing Syrian dish featuring star anise and sugar-free-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Wash quinces and cut in half. Core out seeds.
Peel garlic cloves, smash with side of knife, then rub into skin of quince halves.
Drizzle each quince half with olive oil and sprinkle salt evenly over the surface of the quince.
Place star anise pods on top of each quince half, cover with a piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil.
Bake for 15 minutes. Remove from oven, carefully turn quinces over and bake for another 10 minutes.
Let cool in baking sheet to achieve ice-bath-shock effect.
Carefully remove quinces from oven, slice into wedges and serve as a snack.
